Welcome to PARC!
PARC is a student-driven research community that connects motivated learners with researchers to explore ideas in artificial intelligence, machine learning, statistics, optimization, forecasting, and data science.

title: About PARC
text:
The rapid growth of artificial intelligence and data science has created exciting opportunities for students worldwide. However, moving from learning concepts and implementing projects to conducting meaningful research can often be challenging.
Research requires more than technical knowledge. It involves developing the ability to:
PARC was created to provide a space where motivated students can gradually develop these skills through exposure to research, discussion, and collaboration.

title: PARC
text:
Why PARC?
Moving from coursework to research is often challenging. Research requires more than implementing algorithms—it involves asking meaningful questions, understanding scientific literature, designing reliable experiments, and collaborating with others.
PARC provides an open environment where students can develop these skills through discussion, collaboration, and hands-on research activities.

title: PARC
text:
What We Do



📚 Reading Groups
Explore recent research papers in artificial intelligence, machine learning, probabilistic modelling, reinforcement learning, forecasting, and data science through interactive discussions.



🧠 Research Skills
Learn practical research skills including literature review, experiment design, reproducible computing, and scientific communication.



🌱 Open Projects
Collaborate on research-oriented projects, reproduce published work, and contribute to open-source scientific software.

title: PARC
text:
Founded by
PARC was founded by Anubhab Biswas, a PhD researcher at (SUPSI), Mendrisio, Switzerland 🇨🇭 and affiliated with the Università della Svizzera italiana (USI), Lugano, Switzerland 🇨🇭.
The initiative was created with the goal of making research in probabilistic AI, forecasting, and data science more accessible to motivated students and early-career researchers.
As PARC grows, we aim to bring together researchers and learners who share a passion for scientific discovery, open research, collaboration, and knowledge exchange.
→ Learn more about the team on the People page.

title: About PARC
text:
Our Vision
We envision a community where students from diverse backgrounds can access research experiences, learn from one another, and develop the confidence to pursue scientific careers.
We believe that curiosity and dedication are fundamental drivers of research. Access to guidance, discussions, and a research environment can help students take their first steps towards independent exploration.

title: About PARC
text:
Our Mission
PARC focuses on three key objectives:

Research Exposure
Introduce students to current developments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, reinforcement learning, optimization, probabilistic modelling, forecasting, statistics, and data science through reading groups, workshops, and collaborative activities.


Research Skills
Help students develop the practical skills needed for research:

reading scientific literature,
formulating research questions,
designing experiments,
reproducible computational practices,
scientific communication.



Research Community
Create connections between students and researchers, encouraging open discussions, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

title: About PARC
text:
Our Principles

Curiosity
We encourage asking questions, exploring new ideas, and learning beyond traditional coursework.


Rigor
We value careful reasoning, reliable experimentation, and responsible scientific practices.


Openness
We believe research progresses through sharing knowledge, tools, and ideas.


Collaboration
We see research as a collective process where diverse perspectives lead to better discoveries.

title: About PARC
text:
Looking Ahead
PARC begins as a small, research-oriented community built around discussion and collaboration.
Over time, we hope to bring together students and researchers from different institutions and create more opportunities for learning, exploration, and open scientific contributions.

title: About PARC
text:
How We Approach Research
PARC believes that research is developed through curiosity, careful scientific thinking, and collaboration.
We encourage students to go beyond simply applying existing methods and develop the ability to ask questions, evaluate ideas critically, and explore new directions.
We promote an open research culture where knowledge, tools, and experiences are shared to help everyone learn and grow.

title: Activities
text:
PARC organizes research-oriented activities designed to help students explore artificial intelligence, machine learning, forecasting, and data science beyond traditional coursework.
Our activities focus on developing research skills, encouraging scientific discussions, and creating opportunities for collaboration.

title: Activities
text:
Research Reading Groups

Learning through scientific literature
Reading research papers is one of the most important skills for becoming a researcher.
PARC reading groups provide a space for students to explore recent research papers, discuss ideas, and learn how scientific contributions are developed.
Topics may include:

probabilistic machine learning,
forecasting and time series,
statistical learning,
artificial intelligence,
data science applications.

Participants learn how to:

understand research papers,
analyse methodologies,
discuss limitations,
identify possible research directions.

title: Activities
text:
Research Skills Workshops

Building the foundations for research
Research involves skills that are often learned through experience.
PARC workshops focus on practical aspects of research, including:

finding and reading scientific literature,
formulating research questions,
designing computational experiments,
reproducible research practices,
scientific communication.

Workshops may be delivered by researchers and collaborators from different academic backgrounds.

title: Activities
text:
Collaborative Research Projects

Learning by doing
Research skills develop through practice.
PARC encourages small collaborative projects where students can explore ideas, reproduce existing work, and develop their understanding of research methodology.
Projects may involve:

implementing research methods,
analysing datasets,
exploring new approaches,
developing open-source tools.

The focus is on learning the research process rather than only achieving final results.

title: Activities
text:
Research Talks and Discussions

Connecting with researchers
PARC hosts discussions with researchers and early-career scientists who share their experiences, research journeys, and perspectives on different areas of AI and data science.
These sessions provide students with insights into:

academic research,
graduate studies,
research careers,
current developments in the field.

title: Join PARC
text:
Who can join?
PARC welcomes students who are:

curious about research and scientific discovery,
interested in AI, machine learning, statistics, forecasting, or data science,
willing to actively participate in discussions and activities,
motivated to learn and contribute.

Previous research experience is not required. Curiosity and commitment are the most important requirements.

title: Join PARC
text:
How to join
To maintain a focused and collaborative environment, new members are invited after a short conversation with the PARC team.
The conversation helps us understand your interests, background, and how you would like to participate in the community.

title: Join PARC
text:
What we expect from members
PARC is built around active participation. Members are encouraged to:

engage in reading groups and discussions,
share ideas and perspectives,
contribute to collaborative projects,
present topics or research they find interesting.
